back: h(t) = A·h(t−1) + B·u(t) and y(t) = C·h(t). A is the state change, B the input path, C the readout.
Recurrence (one step at a time, for inference) and convolution with K(k) = C·Aᵏ·B (parallel, for training).
A structured initialization of A (HiPPO) for long memory, and a fast, stable way to compute the kernel.

front: What does Mamba add to S4?
back: Selection: B, C and the step size depend on the input. It runs with a hardware-aware scan in linear time.

front: When are SSMs worth trying for forecasting?
back: Very long inputs or high-frequency data. Always compare with a linear model, PatchTST and boosted trees first.
